stances.quote: I am committed to ensuring our armed forces have the tools and resources they need to protect our nation from all the threats we face.
stances.reasoning: Explicit commitment to providing tools and resources for armed forces indicates support for military spending.

stances.quote: Most importantly, the FairTax would allow American workers to keep more of their hard-earned paychecks and only pay taxes on what they spend.
stances.reasoning: Advocacy for FairTax to let workers keep more paychecks shows clear preference for lower taxes.

stances.quote: That’s why I plan to look for opportunities in Congress to right-size the federal government and re-align its operations within the bounds of the U.S. Constitution.
stances.reasoning: Calls to right-size government and root out waste indicate preference for reduced spending.
